notes.title: Chinese Dubbing and Profile Update
notes.notes:
The long-awaited Chinese dubbing is here! Thank you to all our Chinese-speaking broadcasters for their patience but we are very happy to announce that NFB is now completely dubbed into Mandarin.

And not just that, oh no! We've also decided to completely redesign how we save your progress.

The game now has a 'Profile' system where all of your individual save games and playthroughs, rushes, adverts, epilogues and rewards are saved together under an overarching Profile.
All of your progress is kept together in one place, and you can have as many profiles as you'd like, so your Grandma can start her own game if she wants. You go grandma.

If you're new to the game, simply create a profile and you're good to go. Existing players can either combine their existing saves into a profile, convert individual games or start a new one. We save your Legacy saves in case you want to convert them later, but feel free to delete them to save space on your system.

We hope you're all staying safe and well. Our love goes out to all of our Broadcasters facing difficult times.

NotGames x

notes.title: The 'Play Your Way' Update is OUT NOW
notes.notes:
We did it! Another update.

[previewyoutube=5b0w8920c5g;full][/previewyoutube]

First, as always a quick thank you to all the Broadcasters that have brought Not For Broadcast to this point. We are now frighteningly close to beginning principal photography on Episode Three, but first,  it’s time for another update - and it’s a big one! 

Alongside bug fixes and optimisations the Play Your Way Update includes:

Full Controller Support
You can now play the entire game on the controller of your choice - with fully-remappable controls and on-screen prompts.

Difficulty Modes
Whether you’re a veteran broadcaster looking for a new challenge, or if all that stress just isn’t your vibe - there’s a mode for you. NFB now includes 3 levels of difficulty: Intern, Broadcaster and Showrunner. At each level the broadcast room is more intense, and the audience at home more fickle. 

Story Mode
On top of that we’re introducing Story Mode. Here you can focus on enjoying the story of NFB without any of the stress. Edit the news without those pesky extra mechanics and multi-tasking to worry about. 

Customisable Gameplay
But we’ve gone EVEN FURTHER. We are now putting the power in players’ hands to truly ‘Play Your Way’. 
In the past, we’ve been reticent about changing the core experience of the game because we believe that the feeling of stress is integral to the story we are telling. But we also believe that players should be able to play their games in the way that works best for them. So, although we have our vision for how we think Not For Broadcast should feel to players, we want to hand that decision to you.
New Custom Difficulty allows you to individually alter the difficulty of, or even turn off, certain mechanics if they are negatively affecting your experience of the game.

Accessibility Settings
We’ve added a range of accessibility settings to support our players with various visual, audio and motor needs. You can now change the size, colour and background of subtitles, remove confusing visual effects, turn on visual HUD cues, as well as extensive colourblind support where important colours can be individually customised. 

Alternate Video Format
We now have a version of the game with an alternate video player with the video content in a different format for systems that aren’t displaying video correctly. To download it, right click Not for Broadcast and go to Properties. Under the Betas tab select Alternate Video and redownload the game. 

We hope you enjoy this latest batch of features, but there’s no time to relax!
We’ll be shooting the ending of the game over the summer in our longest and most complicated shoot yet. Simultaneously we’ll be beavering away on an overhaul to the Challenges. Our next update is still on schedule for the end of Summer/start of Autumn. You can read more about the future of NFB in the roadmap here. 

Thanks to all of you for your support and a big thank you to our Accessibility Focus Group for their feedback. 

Keep Broadcasting,
NotGames

notes.title: Updated Roadmap to Release!
notes.notes:
Greetings Broadcasters!

It's been a while since we updated our roadmap and since a global pandemic came and did its business all over our previous schedule -  so we thought it's high time we posted an update!

A Sincere Thank You
First and foremost, thank you to everyone who has bought the game, left a review or been a part of this incredible community. It means everything to have such a loyal band of Broadcasters behind us through the Early Access process.

Last time we were stunned at being Overwhelmingly Positive at 1,000 reviews. Now we're at over 4,000 reviews and STILL at that summit! So thank you all. (Except you Tim. You know what you did.)

Where We Are Now

As the UK starts to ease its third national lockdown, the pandemic has had a huge impact on the production of NFB, but nevertheless in the last year we managed to put out more content than we initially intended.

 6 Full Broadcasts
 2 Bonus Broadcasts
 New Game Modes and Challenges
 Community-led Features
 An OST
 A Feature-Length Documentary about making FMV in a pandemic


Still to Come
So, with all that we HAVE done, what have we still got in store? Well check out our updated roadmap all the way up to our full 1.0 release. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35733451/8f5ad35fe77014f848d26b05f05193054a23a125.png

So there you have it. Where we’ve been, where we are, and what we’ve got in store for you.

We hope you’re as excited to play it all as we are to deliver it to you. It’s been a long road, but we promise it’ll be worth sticking through to the finish.

Have a National Newsy Night,

notes.title: The Telethon Update is coming on September 30th!
notes.notes:
Ladies, gentlemen, and other gentlepersons!

Tonight, we're ready to tell you a bit more about the upcoming bonus chapter update we've mentioned a couple of weeks ago.

First off, here's the trailer. Take a gander:

[previewyoutube=h8bnu_7FRBc;full][/previewyoutube]

Now, let's get into more details.

The Telethon

Without spoilering anything, we'll just say that this bonus chapter is set in the 50s, and its plot revolves around a TV fundraiser for terminally ill children... and of course, it goes horribly wrong. The chapter features some of your favorite characters from the original timeline and their relatives, expanding the lore of our universe. 

We’re Tri-Lingual!

Over the course of the past 3 months or so, we at NotGames have been working on getting all the audio for Not For Broadcast dubbed into both Russian and Chinese, which we’re very excited about delivering to our audience in this update. 

That’s everything - levels, tutorials, phone calls, and adverts, up to AND INCLUDING the Surprise Bonus Level, will now have the option to be played completely in Russian and Chinese! And we will, of course, be continuing to support this dubbing going forward, with all future updates including all three languages. 

Challenge Room

The Challenge Room was the second major feature in our recent Lockdown Update. While we’re proud of the 4 challenges currently available,  we are aiming to add at least one more (hopefully two), as well as introducing some delightful rewards for players that complete them. We’re also going to add some of the Lockdown Levels to the existing challenges, and generally give the whole challenge system a bit of much needed spit and polish!

Good morning (or afternoon/evening for our international viewers),

Some of you fine people may have experienced a somewhat inconvenient bug where you'd hang up on Dave in the Second Broadcast (and frankly who could blame you), and then the store would prove to be rather petulant and refuse to let you continue.

Well, we gave it a jolly good talking to and said that sometimes hearing Dave for the umpteenth time isn't as fun as just not hearing his drunken rambles. I'm happy to say the Store came round to our point of view and this is now fixed.

So, now you can hang up on Dave on Day 8, the Second Broadcast, without fear of getting stuck on the store page thereafter. Huzzah!

Tune in soon for the next exciting episode of:

NFB Patch Notes - The Bug Fixes Anthology

notes.title: Tutorial Hangup Retry Patch
notes.notes:
Broadcasters,

This is but a tiny bug fix for a problem that occurred when you hit retry after hanging up the tutorial. 
Thanks to everyone for your reports and getting in touch so we could sort this so quickly. You guys are simply the best. (Betttter than allll the rest)

notes.title: Week 2 Patch - Windows 7 Fix!
notes.notes:
Friends, Players and even you Tim,

The Week 2 Patch is here!
WINDOWS 7 BUG IS FIXED
And we are overcome with emotions (joy, excitement, hunger) to announce we have a fix for the performance problem affecting Windows 7 users. 

The problem was a bug which wasn't allowing videos to decode on the hardware properly.
But now that horrible bug has been squashed by the Newspaper of Destiny.

We want to thank you ALL for bearing with us during this issue and especially every single one of the players who got in touch across different platforms to help out. From sending diagnostics to testing builds and even beyond (thanks Riccardo), we are so grateful to all of you.

As always, if you have any other problems, or if this doesn't solve your issue then let us know in the forums or on Discord!

Happy Broadcasting,
NotGames
